testimonials.quote: Birashimishije cyane. Hollywood Hotel isobanura ubwiza bundi bushya — kuva mu nzu y'imbere nini kugeza ku hantu ho kuruhukira hejuru, buri kantu kanoze.
testimonials.author: Jean-Paul R.

testimonials.quote: Twakoreye ibirori byacu bya buri mwaka mu cyumba cy'inama kinini. Ikipe yari idasanzwe kandi amafunguro yari ku rwego rw'isi. Tuzagaruka buri mwaka.
testimonials.author: Marie Claire U.

testimonials.quote: Presidential Suite yari itandukanye n'ibyo nigeze mbona byose. Spa na pisine mu gitondo cyakurikiyeho byabigize byiza cyane.
testimonials.author: David K.

cta.title: Witeguye Kuba Muri Hollywood?
cta.description: Fata umwanya wawe uyu munsi winjire mu isi aho buri kantu gateguriwe kugushimisha.

conferenceSection.title: Inama, Ubukwe n'Ibirori
conferenceSection.description: Tegurira inama cyangwa ibirori byawe mu bibanza byacu by'akataraboneka. Yaba inama zikomeye mu cyumba kigezweho cyangwa ubukwe n'ibirori by'umunezero mu ihema rinini (Tent) rigezweho riri mu busitani.

wellnessSection.title: Kuruhuka
wellnessSection.description: Komeza gahunda yawe yo kwita ku buzima bwiza mu nzu yacu y'imyitozo (Gym) igezweho kandi yuzuye ibikoresho. Uhasanga ibikoresho by'ikoranabuhanga rigezweho byo kongera imbaraga no gutuma amaraso atembera neza

corridors.title: Ihuriro rya Nyagatare & Rwimiyaga
corridors.description: Iherereye neza ku muhanda wa kaburimbo wa Kagitumba i Rwimiyaga, ikorohereza abayigana kwinjira, guhagarika imodoka mu mutekano no kugera i Nyagatare.

corridors.title: Irembo rya Pariki y'Igihugu y'Akagera
corridors.description: Ahantu heza cyane abasura Pariki y'Akagera bacumbika bashaka ibyumba byiza, amazi ashyushye, amafunguro meza na spa yo kuruhukiramo.

corridors.title: Inzira ya Gatsibo, Gabiro & Kayonza
corridors.description: Ikorohereza abayobozi, abakozi b'imiryango mpuzamahanga n'abitabira inama bakorera hagati ya Gabiro, Gatsibo, Kayonza na Nyagatare.

corridors.title: Umupaka wa Kagitumba (One-Stop Border)
corridors.description: Hoteli ya mbere ku banyamahanga, abacuruzi bakomeye n'abadiplomate binjira mu Rwanda banyuze mu muhanda wa Uganda–Rwanda.

corridors.title: Inzira ya Rwamagana & Kigali
corridors.description: Umuhanda mwiza wa kaburimbo uhuza Kigali, Rwamagana, Kayonza n'ibigo by'ubucuruzi byo mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba ukagera kuri Hollywood Hotel.

corridors.title: Inama z'Intara n'Ubukwe Bwiza
corridors.description: Ikibanza cyizewe mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba ku nama za minisiteri, amahugurwa n'ubukwe bukomeye mu ihema ryo mu busitani.

faqs.question: Ni ukubera iki Hollywood Hotel ifatwa nka hoteli ya mbere i Nyagatare (best hotel in Nyagatare) no mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba?
faqs.answer: Hollywood Hotel i Rwimiyaga mu Karere ka Nyagatare ni yo hoteli ya mbere i Nyagatare n'iy'icyitegererezo mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba, ihuza ibyumba 100+ byiza na VIP suites, salle z'inama zigezweho, ihema ry'ubukwe ryakira abantu 500+, Hollywood Bar, resitora, gym, sauna na spa.

faqs.question: Hollywood Hotel iherereye hehe mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba?
faqs.answer: Hollywood Hotel iherereye ku Muhanda wa Kagitumba i Rwimiyaga, Akarere ka Nyagatare, mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba, u Rwanda — byoroshye kuyigeraho uvuye i Kigali, Rwamagana, Kayonza, Gatsibo, mu mujyi wa Nyagatare no ku mupaka wa Kagitumba.

faqs.question: Hollywood Hotel iri kure hangana iki uvuye kuri Pariki y'Akagera, Nyagatare, Gatsibo, Kayonza n'Umupaka wa Kagitumba?
faqs.answer: Iherereye ku muhanda mukuru wa kaburimbo wa Kagitumba mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba, Hollywood Hotel ikorohereza kugera vuba mu mujyi wa Nyagatare, i Gabiro na Gatsibo, Kayonza na Rwamagana, ku mupaka wa Kagitumba no ku marembo y'uburasirazuba n'amajyaruguru ya Pariki y'Akagera.

faqs.question: Ni ayahe moko y'ibyumba n'ibiciro Hollywood Hotel itanga mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba?
faqs.answer: Dutanga ibyiciro bine by'ibyumba bifite ibiciro bisobanutse mu mafaranga y'u Rwanda: Standard (kuva kuri 50,000 RWF/ijoro), Superior (kuva kuri 80,000 RWF/ijoro), Deluxe ifite balcony n'ibiro (kuva kuri 120,000 RWF/ijoro), na Executive Suite (kuva kuri 200,000 RWF/ijoro), byose birimo Wi-Fi yihuta na serivisi ya 24/7.

faqs.question: Ese Hollywood Hotel yakira inama, ibirori n'ubukwe mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba?
faqs.answer: Yego. Hollywood Hotel ifite salle y'inama igezweho yakira abantu 150+ ifite ikoranabuhanga ry'amashusho ya 4K na Wi-Fi yihuta, ndetse n'ihema rinini ryo mu busitani ry'ubukwe n'ibirori ryakira abantu 500+.

faqs.question: Nabona nte icyumba cyangwa nkabika umwanya w'inama muri Hollywood Hotel?
faqs.answer: Ushobora gusaba icyumba online 24/7 unyuze kuri hollywoodhotel.rw/rw/book cyangwa ukavugana ako kanya n'abakozi bacu kuri telefoni/WhatsApp +250 788 876 479 cyangwa imeyili hollywoodhotel01@gmail.com.
